summary: Design is well-structured but assumes unimplemented changes. 3 HIGH findings require fixes before proceeding: demo URL safety guard in orchestrator, API client and route extensions for mode parameters, and orchestrator options parameter for mode branching.

findings.title: Missing demo URL safety guard in orchestrator — fixture URLs not blocked when demo mode is OFF
findings.problem: Design claims safety check prevents demo.tata-aig.local URLs from reaching live Playwright when DEMO_MODE is not 'true', but this code does not exist. Current startScan() has no URL validation.
findings.impact: Fixture URLs could accidentally be sent to live scan engine, violating safety boundary requirement 9.1
findings.fix: Add URL validation after license enforcement: check if scanMode !== 'main-domain' with demo URLs and reject scan with error message 'Fixture URLs detected outside demo mode — scan blocked for safety.'

findings.title: API client createScan method signature is incomplete — missing scan_mode and selected_urls parameters
findings.problem: Current signature: createScan(targetUrl, urlPattern). Design requires: createScan(targetUrl, urlPattern, scanMode = 'one-page', selectedUrls = []). Method must also send these as JSON fields.
findings.impact: Frontend cannot pass mode and selected URLs to backend. Requirements 2.4 and 3.6 fail.
findings.fix: Update createScan method signature to accept scanMode and selectedUrls parameters; include them in the POST body. Also add new discoverUrls(baseUrl) method that POSTs to /scans/discover with base_url field.

findings.title: Backend POST /api/scans route does not accept or store scan_mode and selected_urls
findings.problem: Route destructures only target_url and url_pattern. Design requires route to accept scan_mode and selected_urls, validate them, store scan_mode in database, and pass selectedUrls to startScan() via options.
findings.impact: Backend receives no mode information. Mode branching cannot be triggered. Requirements 7.1, 7.2, 8.1 fail.
findings.fix: Update POST / route to destructure scan_mode (default 'one-page') and selected_urls (default []); validate scan_mode is 'one-page' or 'main-domain'; validate selected_urls is array; include scan_mode in INSERT statement; pass both as options to startScan().

findings.title: Database schema is missing scan_mode column — existing query patterns will fail
findings.problem: Design specifies ALTER TABLE scans ADD COLUMN scan_mode TEXT DEFAULT 'one-page' but column does not exist. New routes that reference scan_mode will fail with 'no such column' error.
findings.impact: Database INSERT/SELECT operations fail when new code is deployed. No scans can be created.
findings.fix: Add 'scan_mode TEXT DEFAULT \'one-page\',' to the scans table CREATE TABLE definition after url_pattern column.

findings.title: scanOrchestrator.startScan signature does not accept options parameter — mode branching cannot happen
findings.problem: Current signature: startScan(scanId, targetUrl, urlPattern, io). Design requires: startScan(scanId, targetUrl, urlPattern, io, options = {}). Options object carries scanMode and selectedUrls needed for mode branching.
findings.impact: Orchestrator cannot receive mode information. Mode branching logic cannot be implemented. Requirements 8.1-8.6 fail.
findings.fix: Update function signature to accept options = {} parameter. Destructure { scanMode = 'one-page', selectedUrls = [] } at start. Replace discovery block with conditional: if 'one-page' use [targetUrl]; if 'main-domain' use selectedUrls; else discover (backward compat). Apply URL pattern only if not 'one-page'.

findings.title: POST /api/scans/discover endpoint does not exist
findings.problem: Design specifies new endpoint that accepts base_url and returns { urls, sitemapFound, demoLabel }. Endpoint is not implemented.
findings.impact: Frontend api.discoverUrls() calls fail. Main Domain discovery step cannot work. Requirements 3.3, 3.4, 9 of acceptance criteria fail.
findings.fix: Add POST /discover route to scans.js (or new discover.js): extract base_url from request; validate it's a valid URL; call discoverAllUrls(base_url); return { urls, sitemapFound, demoLabel: result.demoLabel || null }.

findings.title: startScan callers do not pass options parameter — backward compat works but mode feature is inactive
findings.problem: Even after startScan signature accepts options, existing call sites must be updated. POST / (line 20) and restart endpoint (line 101) do not pass options, so mode information is lost.
findings.impact: Mode data stored in database is not used. Scans always fall back to discovery behavior.
findings.fix: In POST / route: pass { scanMode: scan_mode, selectedUrls: selected_urls } to startScan(). In restart endpoint: read scan_mode from database (COALESCE(scan_mode, 'one-page')); pass { scanMode: scan_mode || 'one-page', selectedUrls: [] } to startScan().

findings.title: Demo fixture file path uses fragile relative path construction
findings.problem: Uses path.join(__dirname, '..', '..', 'data', 'demo-fixtures.json') which works but is relative and fragile if module structure changes.
findings.impact: Minor code clarity; no functional impact.
findings.fix: Use path.resolve(__dirname, '../../data/demo-fixtures.json') or compute DATA_DIR once and reuse it.

findings.title: Design does not specify URL validation rules for DiscoveryPreview component
findings.problem: Spec does not clarify whether empty strings, relative URLs, fragments, or malformed URLs are allowed in the urls prop.
findings.impact: Implementation detail; could lead to ambiguous component behavior.
findings.fix: Add to DiscoveryPreview spec: 'All URLs in the urls prop must be valid absolute HTTP(S) URLs. URLs with fragments or query parameters are allowed but treated as distinct URLs. The component does not validate; assumes backend validation already occurred.'

findings.title: Error message for demo URL safety guard could be clearer about context
findings.problem: Proposed message 'Fixture URLs detected outside demo mode — scan blocked for safety. Enable DEMO_MODE=true...' assumes user intends to enable demo, but user may have accidentally entered demo domain.
findings.fix: Use more explanatory message: 'The domain demo.tata-aig.local is reserved for demo purposes and cannot be scanned in production mode. To run a demo, set DEMO_MODE=true on the backend.'

verified_assumptions: Demo mode implementation (isDemoMode, loadDemoFixtures) already exists and is correct
Demo fixtures file exists with correct structure and 7 URLs
License service exports TRIAL_PAGE_LIMIT=3 and getLicenseState()
API client is a thin HTTP wrapper with no business logic
scanOrchestrator follows discovery → crawl → analyze flow
Database schema is extensible (no blocker columns)
NewScan.jsx exists with single URL input
unverified_wrong_assumptions: Demo URLs are blocked when demo mode is OFF — code missing
API client createScan accepts scanMode and selectedUrls — not present
POST /api/scans accepts scan_mode and selected_urls — not handled
startScan accepts options parameter — signature incomplete
scan_mode column exists in scans table — missing
recommendation: Do not proceed to implementation. Fix the 3 HIGH findings first (safety guard, API signatures, options parameter). These are prerequisites. MEDIUM findings are follow-on changes needed for completeness. NIT findings are optional improvements.
